chunks.text: Having taken note of what your honour is pleased to advise me in your letter of the 26th of last month, and wishing to fulfil my desire to serve and please the gentlemen of the Committee and your honour, I shall make new sketches for the pendentives in agreement with my brother-in-law Don Francisco Bayeu, and, once he has approved them on the terms the gentlemen of the Committee decide, I shall go on to paint them in the dome, doing there too whatever my said brother-in-law thinks fit.
